label: mid/late original-phase input of d/b (and e,w,k,m,v,3,s) in sequences starting with 0/j/g/i/1/n/2
explanation: Fires only in the original phase, at positions t>=3 (peak t=5-6; rate rises with orig_idx), never at the delimiter or during copy. Input-token selective: d carries 47% of mass (12x lift), then b (5x), e, w, k, m, v, 3, s; nearly silent on h, x, u and others. Mostly on first occurrence of the token (89% of mass). Strongly modulated by sequence context: much more likely when the sequence starts with 0 (4.7x), j, g, i, 1, n, 2; d inputs in sequences starting with such tokens are active 83% of the time. The input-token set gives ~97% recall but only 12% precision; adding the first-token condition gives F1 ~0.43, mass recall ~0.74. Remaining gating depends on an unidentified distributed composition of the earlier prefix. Largest activations are on d at t>=4.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=5: d, b, w, k; t=6: d, b, w, k; t=7: d, b, w, k) and the first original token (most: 0, j, g, i, 1, n; least: m, w, k, d); timing cues that raise it most: t=5, L=9 & t=8, L=9 & t=7.
